HOW TO SMASH

Smash on the beatTap a pumpkin or pie as the beat ring closes for PERFECT. Combos raise the multiplier up to ×8.
Golden pumpkinWorth 5× points and extra Super charge. Grab it fast.
Gravy boatNever hit Grandma’s gravy boat: it costs a life. Letting a pumpkin or pie escape costs one too.
Cranberry bombSmash the cranberry with the lit fuse to blow up all of its neighbors at once.
Boss turkeyEvery 4 levels a giant turkey appears in the center. Hit it until its health bar is gone before time runs out.
Power upsGolden corn = 2× points · Frozen clock = slow time · Battery = extra life.
Super SmashSmashes fill the meter. When full press SUPER, Space or two finger tap for a ground pound that clears the whole field.
Fever & leavesCombo 20 starts Fever (×1.5). Leaf gusts hide a row. Anything that escapes under them doesn't cost a life.
Keyboard: QWE / ASD / ZXC or numpad smash the 9 holes · Space/F Super · P pause · M mute
